title: Accordion study
scenario: Linked crease pattern, folded preview, exact edit, rejection, undo and measurement.
backend: Offline headless Google Chrome 158.0.8127.37, Moxi orthographic projection and SVG
fixture: Six synthetic rigid panels, 20 mm pitch, 40 mm depth, initial 30° tilt
reproduce:
From repository root: examples/foldable-motif/build.sh /tmp/accordion.html
node examples/foldable-motif/check.cjs /tmp/accordion.html /tmp/accordion-frames
Requires locally installed C++20, Python 3, Node, Playwright and Chrome.

slides.caption: Starting pleat
slides.action: Open the generated editor from disk.
slides.expected: Six flat panels and six folded faces share selection. The 20 mm / 30° patch spans 103.9 mm and rises 10.0 mm.

slides.caption: Preview a steeper tilt
slides.action: Pick folded panel 4, pick flat panel 2, move to panel 3 with the keyboard, then take the slider to 75°.
slides.expected: Panel 3 stays highlighted across views. The preview narrows the folded patch while the flat pattern keeps the same dimensions.

slides.caption: Change pitch and tilt together
slides.action: Cancel the preview. Set pitch to 24.5 mm and tilt to 60°, then press Enter.
slides.expected: The flat sheet widens to 147 mm. The folded span is 73.5 mm and rise is 21.2 mm alongside the starting figures.

slides.caption: Reject a closed fold
slides.action: Submit 90° outside the supported tilt range.
slides.expected: The draft shows 90° and a rejection message. The folded geometry and current comparison retain the 60° solution.

slides.caption: Undo the last valid edit
slides.action: Click Undo after the rejected draft.
slides.expected: Both views and numeric controls return to the starting configuration. Selection stays on panel 3.

slides.caption: Track one crease through the fold
slides.action: Measure crease 3, enter a 60° tilt and apply.
slides.expected: The central note reports 17.3 mm height. A dashed line on the surface traces the front endpoint over the permitted tilt range.
